pr_title: drivers: ieee802154: rf2xx: Fix OpenThread ACK error
pr_body:
At OpenThread stack on **ieee802154_radio_handle_ack** method the **net_pkt_read** fail because **net_pkt_cursor** wasn't proper initialized. This ensures that **net_pkt_cursor** is initialized for any ack frame.
Another hidden problem fixed was the **frags** property on **net_buf**. Now it is defined as NULL to ensures that no fragments are available.

This uses commit from #23249
Fixes #23595

issue_context.title: RF2XX driver Openthread ACK handling
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

When using the RF2XX IEEE802.15.4 driver with OpenThread on a NXP K64 platform, I am regularly seeing the following messages:
```
[01:00:38.018,000] <err> net_otPlat_radio: Failed to read ACK frame.
[01:00:38.018,000] <inf> ieee802154_rf2xx: ACK packet not handled.
```

**Expected behavior**
ACKs are handled just fine.

**Impact**
OpenThread works as expected, but I am not sure whether there is still a problem lingering.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux
 - Toolchain: Zephyr SDK, 0.11.2
 - Commit SHA: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/c1c54b13a6ec93c74d674e365e3e0cae80de531c
comments: @nandojve Tested on the OT NCP sample and the messages are gone.
